text.tspan: The six books on one axis, 1341–1450 · epilogue 1553
Book spans above, historical record events around the axis. Gold: saga Pact milestones. Red: battles. Tan: treaties and politics.
Dates follow the record: Jogaila b. c. 1362, Vytautas c. 1350. The Silent Pact, the flame and the Last Flame are the saga's own thread through it.
